# `uuid`

[External Documentation](https://www.npmjs.com/package/uuid) 

UUID package to generate RFC4122 UUIDs.

#### Example

```javascript

const result_uuid = uuid.v4();
$_RETURN_DATA_ = result_uuid;
      
```
